contribution_decision: Continue physical long-return damping as primary and matched finite-duration band transfer as fallback. Moving reflection gluing has relative angular rate 2 Omega. Its specified corotating classical junction requires J of order P Omega, larger than the electric-only load by d/P. The projected classical multiplication source remains O(q Omega), and its accumulated bound tends to zero on the proposed damping time. These frame, transport and continuity ingredients are established methods; no physical quantum state, renormalized stress theorem, smooth junction or consequential novelty is accepted.
next_decisive_question: Determine the coupled finite-time angular/electric quantum state, compact rotation sector and physical return with the moving reflection load retained; control renormalized stress, omitted response and smooth semiclassical matching before accepting the physical endpoint.
proof_review_limits: No derivation of full binary tetrad transport, the interacting compact/non-Abelian state, renormalized stress, finite-flux physical return or smooth quantum-open junction. This is not a full literature/novelty exit.
